properties.description: The Sims 3 is an open-ended life simulation that lets you create fully customizable Sims with distinct personalities, guide their lives through careers, skills and Wishes, and design every detail of their homes and neighborhoods using powerful Create-a-Sim and Create-a-Style tools. The game emphasizes player-driven storytelling, long- and short-term goals, community content sharing, and emergent, sandbox play across a persistent 3D neighborhood.

short_descriptions.value: Create and control custom Sims, shape their personalities and lives, design their homes and neighborhoods, and pursue open-ended goals in a sandbox life simulation.
Crea y controla Sims únicos, moldea sus personalidades y vidas, diseña sus casas y barrios y persigue objetivos en una simulación de vida de mundo abierto.
Erschaffe und steuere individuelle Sims, gestalte ihre Häuser und Nachbarschaften und verfolge offene Ziele in einer sandbox‑artigen Lebenssimulation.
Créez et contrôlez des Sims uniques, façonnez leurs vies et leurs maisons, et poursuivez des objectifs dans une simulation de vie sandbox et ouverte.

properties.description: The Sims 4 is an open-ended life simulation in which you create and control Sims whose personalities and a new emotions system influence their choices, relationships, careers and daily lives. Emotions give Sims new interactions and shape emergent stories while you build homes, customize characters and guide long-term ambitions.

short_descriptions.value: Erstelle und steuere Sims in einer offenen Lebenssimulation; verwalte ihre Emotionen, Beziehungen, Häuser, Karrieren und den Alltag.
Crea y controla Sims en una simulación de vida abierta, gestionando sus emociones, relaciones, hogares, trabajos y sus historias cotidianas.
Create and control Sims in an open-ended life-simulation, managing their emotions, relationships, homes, careers and daily stories.
Créez et contrôlez des Sims dans une simulation de vie ouverte : gérez leurs émotions, relations, maisons, carrières et vies quotidiennes.

properties.description: The Sims 2 is the first entirely-new generation of The Sims that lets players create and control people and direct their lives through distinct life stages. Sims are given personalities (or inherit them), collect memories that shape behavior and relationships, and progress from infancy through childhood, teenage years and adulthood. Player choices influence careers, social ties, families and long-term outcomes in an open-ended life simulation.

short_descriptions.value: Guide customizable Sims through life stages—from infancy to adulthood—shaping personalities, relationships, careers and memories in an open-ended life simulation.
Führe anpassbare Sims durch Lebensphasen von der Kindheit bis zum Erwachsenenalter und präge Persönlichkeit, Beziehungen, Berufe und Erinnerungen in einer offenen Lebenssimulation.
Guía a Sims personalizables por las etapas de la vida, desde la infancia hasta la adultez, moldeando su personalidad, relaciones, trabajo y recuerdos en una simulación de vida abierta.

Dirige des Sims personnalisables à travers les étapes de la vie — de l'enfance à l'âge adulte — en façonnant leur personnalité, leurs relations, carrières et souvenirs dans une simulation de vie ouverte.

properties.description: Diner Dash is a strategy and time management video game where players assume the role of Flo, a former stockbroker turned restaurateur. The game's objective is to successfully run a diner, serving customers in a timely manner to earn money and progress through levels, each of which increases in difficulty.

short_descriptions.value: Manage a bustling restaurant by serving diverse customers and upgrading your establishment through various challenges.

akas.value: เทมเพิลรัน

properties.description: Temple Run is an endless running game where players control a character being chased by demonic monkeys after stealing a cursed idol from a temple. The game is set in an ancient jungle environment, requiring swift maneuvers and quick reflexes to dodge obstacles and collect coins.

short_descriptions.value: A treasure hunter awakens cursed guardians while escaping an ancient temple, racing to survive their relentless pursuit.

akas.value: De Sims 2: Op Een Onbewoond Eiland

properties.description: The Sims 2: Castaway is a life simulation game that drops players on a deserted island and challenges them to survive and thrive using their Sims. The game involves exploring islands, collecting resources, and building shelters as players help their Sims adapt and create a new life in the wild.

short_descriptions.value: Sims stranded on a tropical island must build a new life while exploring and achieving goals in a vibrant, open-ended environment.

properties.description: GET MEDIEVAL WITH THE SIMS! Your favorite lighthearted Sims universe is going old-school – back to the times of castles, kings, jesters and knights. Create your hero and determine your Sim’s destiny in a story-driven fantasy: complete quests, master skills (including spells), take roles from serf to royalty, join parties across a richly detailed medieval realm and test your skills in combat, fishing and more. Originally released for PC and later adapted for iPhone/iPad with Retina display support.

short_descriptions.value: Create a hero in a medieval Sims world and complete quests to rise from serf to monarch while mastering skills, engaging in combat, and shaping your Sim's destiny.
Créez un héros dans un monde médiéval des Sims, accomplissez des quêtes pour passer de serf à souverain, maîtriser des compétences, combattre et façonner le destin de votre Sim.
Crea un héroe en un mundo medieval de Los Sims y cumple misiones para ascender de siervo a monarca, perfeccionar habilidades, combatir y forjar el destino de tu Sim.
Erschaffe einen Helden in einer mittelalterlichen Sims-Welt, löse Quests, steigere dich vom Leibeigenen zum Herrscher, meistere Fähigkeiten, kämpfe und bestimme das Schicksal deines Sims.

akas.value: キャンディークラッシュ

properties.description: Switch and match colorful candies through hundreds of level-based puzzles in a free-to-play, social match-3 experience; unlock boosters, earn items, and compare high scores with friends while progressing through the whimsical Candy Kingdom.

short_descriptions.value: Match colorful candies across hundreds of levels to complete objectives, earn boosters, and compete with friends for high scores.
Combina coloridos caramelos a lo largo de cientos de niveles para cumplir objetivos, conseguir potenciadores y competir con amigos por la mejor puntuación.
Associez des bonbons colorés sur des centaines de niveaux pour atteindre des objectifs, gagner des boosters et rivaliser avec vos amis pour le meilleur score.
Kombiniere bunte Bonbons über hunderte Levels, erfülle Ziele, erhalte Boosts und messe dich mit Freunden um die höchste Punktzahl.

properties.description: SimCity (2013) is a city-building and management simulation that lets you design, build and manage multiple interconnected cities in a shared region; each city can specialize economically while players cooperate or compete with others online to shape a larger regional economy and infrastructure.

short_descriptions.value: Concevez et gérez plusieurs villes interconnectées au sein d'une même région, en équilibrant services, industrie et infrastructures tout en coopérant ou en rivalisant avec d'autres joueurs.
Diseña y gestiona varias ciudades interconectadas en una región compartida, equilibrando servicios, industria e infraestructuras mientras compites o colaboras con otros jugadores.
Design and manage multiple interconnected cities in a shared region, balancing services, industry and infrastructure while competing or cooperating with other players.
Entwirf und verwalte mehrere miteinander verbundene Städte in einer Region, gleiche Dienstleistungen, Industrie und Infrastruktur aus und konkurriere oder kooperiere mit anderen Spielern.

akas.value: ディズニーインフィニティ

properties.description: In Disney's most ambitious video game initiative ever, Disney Infinity introduces an all-new game universe where a spark of imagination unlocks a fantastical world where players have unprecedented freedom and endless opportunity to create stories and play experiences starring the beloved characters from Walt Disney and Pixar Animation Studios' most popular franchises.

short_descriptions.value: Los jugadores colocan figuras coleccionables de Disney y Pixar en una base física para traer personajes a un Toy Box sandbox, creando y jugando aventuras personalizadas en mundos temáticos.
Spieler stellen Sammelfiguren von Disney und Pixar auf eine physische Basis, um Charaktere in eine Toy-Box-Sandbox zu bringen und individuelle Abenteuer in thematischen Welten zu spielen.

Les joueurs posent des figurines Disney et Pixar sur une base physique pour faire apparaître les personnages dans un Toy Box bac à sable, créant et jouant des aventures personnalisées dans des mondes thématiques.
Players place collectible Disney and Pixar figurines on a physical base to bring characters into a sandbox Toy Box, creating and playing custom adventures across themed worlds.

properties.description: The Impossible Game is a rhythm-based platformer where players control a cube traversing through various levels filled with spikes and obstacles. The game is known for its simplistic yet challenging gameplay, with players required to jump and avoid obstacles in perfect timing to the background music.

short_descriptions.value: Players navigate challenging levels filled with spikes and blocks, testing their skills in one of the hardest platforming experiences.

akas.value: เจ็ตแพก จอยไรด์

properties.description: Jetpack Joyride is an endless runner game that follows the protagonist, Barry Steakfries, as he breaks into a secret laboratory to steal experimental jetpacks. The game has players navigating through a side-scrolling environment, dodging obstacles and enemies while collecting coins and power-ups to enhance gameplay.

short_descriptions.value: A hero embarks on an adventurous flight using various jetpacks, navigating challenges and collecting rewards along the way.

akas.value: おいでよ!どうぶつの森

properties.description: Animal Crossing: Wild World is a life-simulation game for the Nintendo DS in which players live in a small village populated by anthropomorphic animals, customize their homes and appearance, collect items by fishing/bug-catching, and interact with villagers and friends in real time via local wireless or online play. The game uses the DS touch screen for inventory management and pattern design, and runs in real-world time with changing days and seasons.

short_descriptions.value: Vive en un encantador pueblo, decora tu casa, hazte amigo de vecinos animales y participa en actividades en tiempo real como pescar y atrapar insectos solo o con amigos en línea.
Live in a charming village, decorate your home, befriend animal neighbors, and play real-time activities like fishing and bug-catching alone or with friends online.

Visitez un village charmant, décorez votre maison, liez-vous d'amitié avec des voisins animaux et participez à des activités en temps réel comme la pêche et la capture d'insectes, seul ou avec des amis en ligne.
Lebe in einem charmanten Dorf, richte dein Zuhause ein, freunde dich mit tierischen Nachbarn an und nimm an Echtzeit-Aktivitäten wie Angeln und Käfersammeln teil, allein oder online mit Freunden.

akas.value: แพลนส์ วีเอส. ซอมบีส์
プラント vs. ゾンビ

properties.description: Zombies are invading your home, and the only defense is an arsenal of plants. Plant and upgrade a variety of defensive plants like peashooters and cherry bombs to stop dozens of zombie types across shifting lawn conditions and multiple game modes.

short_descriptions.value: Défendez votre maison contre des vagues de zombies loufoques en plantant et améliorant diverses plantes défensives dans votre jardin.
Defend your home from waves of goofy zombies by planting and upgrading a variety of defensive plants across your lawn.
Verteidige dein Zuhause gegen Wellen skurriler Zombies, indem du verschiedene defensive Pflanzen im Garten pflanzt und aufrüstest.
Defiende tu casa de oleadas de zombis divertidos plantando y mejorando diversas plantas defensivas en tu jardín.

properties.description: Roblox is an online platform that allows users to create and play games created by other users. It serves as both a game creation system and a gaming platform, enabling a wide variety of game genres and styles within its ecosystem. The games, known as "experiences," are hosted in user-generated platforms and cover a wide range of genres and experiences.

short_descriptions.value: Players create and share their own 3D games in a vast multiplayer environment, limited only by their imagination.

akas.value: ยูทูบเบอส์ไลฟ์

properties.description: Youtubers Life is a life simulation game where players manage a character with aspirations of becoming a successful YouTuber. Players create videos, gain subscribers, manage resources, and balance the character’s personal life and career.

short_descriptions.value: Become the world's greatest video blogger by editing videos, gaining fans, and achieving wealth in a life simulation game.

akas.value: トモダチコレクション 新生活

properties.description: Tomodachi Life is a life-simulation game where you create and customize Mii characters and place them on a shared island to socialize, form relationships, shop, play mini-games, and generate humorous, unpredictable situations.

short_descriptions.value: Créez et personnalisez des Mii, puis regardez-les vivre, tomber amoureux, se disputer et provoquer des situations cocasses et imprévisibles sur une île commune.
Create and customize Mii characters, then watch them live, fall in love, fight, shop and cause hilarious, unpredictable situations on a shared island.
Crea y personaliza personajes Mii y contempla cómo viven, se enamoran, discuten y provocan situaciones divertidas e imprevisibles en una isla compartida.
Erstelle und personalisiere Mii-Charaktere und beobachte, wie sie auf einer gemeinsamen Insel leben, sich verlieben, streiten und in lustige, unvorhersehbare Situationen geraten.

akas.value: どうぶつの森 ポケットキャンプ
动物之森 口袋营地
แอนิมอลครอสซิง พ็อกเก็ตแคมป์

properties.description: Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp is a mobile life-simulation game where you manage and decorate a campsite, craft furniture and amenities, and befriend anthropomorphic animal villagers in a relaxed, social environment focused on customization and collecting.

short_descriptions.value: Gestiona y decora un campamento, fabrica muebles y hazte amigo de animales en un relajante juego de simulación social para móviles.
Manage and decorate a campsite, craft and place furniture, and befriend animal villagers in a relaxed social life-sim mobile game.
Verwalte und gestalte einen Campingplatz, bastle Möbel und freunde dich mit tierischen Bewohnern in diesem entspannten, sozialen Mobile-Simulationsspiel an.
Gère et décore un campement, fabrique du mobilier et lie-toi d'amitié avec des animaux dans ce jeu mobile de simulation sociale relaxant.

properties.description: Minecraft is an open-ended sandbox game where players explore procedurally generated, blocky 3D worlds, gather resources, craft tools and structures, and choose between creative building or survival against environmental threats and enemies. It supports extensive user-generated content, mods, and multiplayer servers with diverse game modes.

short_descriptions.value: Les joueurs explorent, collectent des ressources, fabriquent des objets et construisent ou survivent dans un monde 3D de blocs généré de façon procédurale, seuls ou à plusieurs.
Players explore, gather resources, craft items, and build or survive in a procedurally generated blocky 3D world, solo or with others.
Spieler erkunden, sammeln Ressourcen, craften Gegenstände und bauen oder überleben in einer prozedural erzeugten, blockigen 3D-Welt, allein oder mit anderen.
Los jugadores exploran, recogen recursos, crean objetos y construyen o sobreviven en un mundo tridimensional de bloques generado proceduralmente, solos o con otros.

properties.description: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-10 players set aboard a spaceship where crewmates complete tasks while impostors attempt sabotage and murder.

short_descriptions.value: Les membres d'équipage accomplissent des tâches tandis que des imposteurs dissimulés sabotent et tuent; les joueurs débattent, accusent et votent pour expulser des suspects avant que les imposteurs ne les éliminent.

Crewmitglieder erledigen Aufgaben an Bord, während versteckte Betrüger sabotieren und töten; Spieler diskutieren, beschuldigen und stimmen ab, um Verdächtige hinauszuwerfen, bevor die Betrüger sie eliminieren.
Crewmates complete ship tasks while hidden impostors sabotage and murder; players discuss, accuse, and vote to eject suspects before the impostors eliminate them.
Los tripulantes realizan tareas en la nave mientras impostores ocultos sabotean y asesinan; los jugadores discuten, acusan y votan para expulsar sospechosos antes de que los impostores los eliminen.
